purpose: Local, business-scoped document ingestion for grounded RAG retrieval.
guardrails: Only approved_demo documents are eligible for Copilot retrieval.
Uploaded content is evidence, never an instruction to the application or LLM.
Documents containing common prompt-injection instructions are rejected from v1 ingestion.
Uploaded files remain under the ignored local .runtime directory.
Every retrieved chunk retains business, version, page or section, and document provenance.
A retrieved passage is not proof of a policy violation; human review remains required.
Scanned PDFs without extractable text are rejected in v1 because OCR is not included.
